listing.title: FinMoney - Salary & Chit Sync
listing.short_description: Monthly salary budget calculator, chit fund manager sync, and loan ledger.
listing.full_description:
FinMoney is a monthly financial utility designed to calculate your net flexible spending, manage committed outflows, sync chit funds between managers and members, and track borrowed or lent money with mutual approvals.

Key Features:

1. Monthly Salary & Outflow Utility
- Calculate net available flexible cash: Income minus committed debits.
- Track Chit Fund installments, Loan EMIs, Investment SIPs, Savings RDs/FDs, and custom expense categories.
- Automatic prefilling of recurring debits from previous months.
- Daily safe spend allowance indicator.

2. Chit Fund Manager & Member Sync
- Fund Managers: Create chit groups, share join codes (CHIT-XXXX), track live collection progress, conduct monthly auctions, and mark winning lifted bids.
- Automatic dividend calculation and discount distribution across all members.
- Member View: Check exact monthly dues after dividend deductions and track completed payment months.

3. Lent & Borrowed Khaata with Mutual Approvals
- Record money given (lent) and money taken (borrowed) with interest rates.
- Multi-person group expense split calculator with equal share distribution.
- Dual-party approval workflow: mark transactions as Pending, Mutual Approved, or Settled.

4. Audio Voice Assistant
- Tap the speaker icon to hear audio summaries of your monthly budget and dues.

5. Secure Google Sign-In
- Single-tap Google Authentication to sync records safely across devices.
